arStrings.szText: "Where are the Midwives and what have you done here?"
They came and left by sea. Took the vessels. Left the husks.
Speak plainly woman. What ritual was performed here?
They gathered the fertile. Ripe like harvest fruits. One by one, split. Another girl. And another. I did not want to be worthy like them. I ruined myself to escape it.
Hollow and broken. Has PTSD over what she's been through

They would have killed me for the waste, but I offered my hands. To cut, to hollow. I laid them in the circle so their Lord might step through. Oh, how he towered—vast, and shining in carrion! Great beyond measure!
Terrible awe speaking about the Demon lord
